findings.title: Identical two-run timestamps (meas-two-run vacuity)
findings.detail: Both runs for a two-run measurement share the exact same timestamp (2026-08-06T02:52:50.858Z). Corpus rules treat back-to-back identical timestamps as evidence that two runs were recorded without independent execution (meas-two-run false-pass pattern). Cannot treat dual-run agreement as verified.

findings.title: lg-result-reproduces flips to true with zero score
findings.detail: lg-result-reproduces changes from ok:false to ok:true while recomputed:0 and recorded:0 remain. A pass with both scores zero does not prove a real score was recomputed and matched; this can be a vacuous pass on an empty/zero result file rather than verified reproducibility of a scored gate.

findings.title: Diff is mostly timestamp churn, not product code
findings.detail: Visible hunks only rewrite measurement-meta timestamps (and one ok flag) across app-builder, az-planting-calendar, fixtures, and pet-sitter. No application source, tests, routes, screenshots, or SOURCES/INTEGRATIONS/COMPETITORS appear in the provided diff. Any claim that pet-sitter product behavior improved at 2b57e2a is not verifiable from this commit content.

findings.title: Truncated middle — full pet-sitter delta not reviewable
findings.detail: The provided diff is middle-truncated at pet-sitter/.redanv. Without the complete unified diff for that path and any omitted files, those changes cannot be verified and do not pass.

findings.title: Cross-app evidence rewritten in pet-sitter commit
findings.detail: Commit claimed for pet-sitter also rewrites measurement-meta for app-builder, az-planting-calendar, known-bad-fixtures, and many orchestrator fixtures. That scope is noise or pollution relative to a pet-sitter product review; it does not establish pet-sitter app correctness.

findings.title: fe-favicon two-run identical stamps in pet-sitter meta
findings.detail: Two consecutive favicon runs both at 2026-08-06T03:36:44.710Z with identical metrics, then another pair both at 2026-08-06T03:36:45.029Z. Paired identical timestamps undermine the two-run independence check.
